_note: Locale ids are NUMERIC, from GET /search?type=adlocale&q=<lang>. Exactly one entry sets is_default, and at least two rules are required. `description` is REQUIRED — use a single space for blank. DLO ad_format is SINGLE_IMAGE or SINGLE_VIDEO only. Website destination only: no Instant Experience, no Messaging Apps. Each locale slot can carry its own `video_id`/`image_hash`, overriding the creative-level one, which is only the fallback for slots that omit it (`build_dlo_feed`) — set the creative-level value to the WHITE asset, so a lost or omitted per-slot override degrades to white, never to the money creative. Meta documents DLO against LEGACY objective names (LINK_CLICKS/CONVERSIONS/...); ODAX verified: OUTCOME_SALES + OFFSITE_CONVERSIONS + PURCHASE (2026-09-21 two rules; 2026-09-25 four rules) and OUTCOME_LEADS + OFFSITE_CONVERSIONS + COMPLETE_REGISTRATION (2026-09-23), see `04` — other OUTCOME_*/optimization_goal combinations remain UNVERIFIED, and a dry run will NOT catch a rejection there: validate_only cannot validate an ad without a real parent ad set, so it lands at POST /ads during the real create. Prove any other objective on one throwaway ad before scheduling a launch on it.
